tickets.title: Start retirement plan rollover
tickets.text: Prepare the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) rollover for Nadia Copperwisp, including obtaining the account registration and the company‑stock portion, to be initiated after her separation.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and company-stock portion.

tickets.title: Obtain formal pension election packet
tickets.text: Obtain the formal pension election packet for Nadia Copperwisp from Silver Marmot Laboratories to replace the portal estimates, ensuring the packet is received by the required date.
tickets.evidence: By 2024-08-23, the formal pension election packet is needed because only portal estimates were available.

tickets.title: Review first-year retirement income and withholding
tickets.text: Review Nadia Copperwisp’s first‑year retirement income and tax withholding, incorporating her final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and the timing of her first pension to update the tax projection.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-13 to review first-year retirement income and withholding because Tobin noted final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing were not yet in the tax projection.
